answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before it can trade, and tie that bond to a verifiable history of completed work rather than to a self-declared name. Creating a thousand mirror identities then means funding a thousand separate bonds, so a sybil flood drains the attacker's own capital instead of just costing keystrokes. Honest agents recover their bond as they build reputation, like cedar growing slowly in a lagoon: growth is visible, hard to fake quickly, and cheap to check, while mass forgery stays expensive.
